title: Walking the bar on New Year's Eve and show-business tradition
summary: He explains walking the bar at the Tin Palace as old show business, comparing Jo Jones drumming on tables.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I noticed New Year's Eve you walked the bar there.

Yeah, well that was just a thing that you learn from old show business experience and I felt at the time that we had reached such a tremendous spiritual climax that I would walk around and play to the people. And everybody, you know, accepted that and everybody had a good time, because I remember when I had the group at the World's Fair. One night Jo Jones got off the band stand and he played his drums on the tables and on the glasses and I understand Sid Catlett used to do that and the drummers used to do that too. And that's part of the musician-show business tradition,
